entities.summary: Ethan Werek, also known as Wei Ruike, is a Chinese-Canadian professional ice hockey forward. Born in Canada. He is currently a free agent. He represented China at the 2022 Winter Olympics. He was selected by the New York Rangers in the 2nd round of the 2009 NHL Entry Draft.
